assertions.assertion: The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229)
precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with sick sinus syndrome, requiring continuous rhythm monitoring to evaluate for bradyarrhythmias or pauses
personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
this mobile cardiac telemetry study is indicated to assess for potential cardioembolic sources such as paroxysmal atrial fibrillation that may contribute to cerebrovascular risk
